First, note:  
12 AM January 20, 1005 in US/Eastern (EST/EDT not relevant for year 1005, assume standard offset).  
Historical time zone data not precise for 1005, but by modern rules:  
US/Eastern = UTC-5, Asia/Shanghai = UTC+8.  
Difference = 8 − (-5) = 13 hours ahead.  

12 AM + 13 hours = 1 PM same day.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1005-01-20 13:00
